name: TEMPESTA URSA

specs.notes: Lamborghini's Urus Performante: the 4.0 twin-turbo V8 at 666 CV (490 kW) and 850 N m, eight-speed automatic, permanent four-wheel drive, ~2,150 kg, 0-100 km/h in 3.3 s, 306 km/h (Lamborghini, dealer spec sheets). Its torque curve, ratios and aero are estimates. Lamborghini publishes no ratios for it: its gearbox is the Audi RS Q8 Performance's, the same eight-speed behind the same 4.0 V8 (auto motor und sport's data: 4.714 / 3.143 / 2.11 / 1.67 / 1.28 / 1.00 / 0.84 / 0.67 on a 3.20 final drive), with its 306 km/h limiter; before October 2026 a 5.18 final drive ran it into the rev limiter in eighth at 306 km/h.

garage.blurb: A super-SUV that thinks it's a supercar: 666 horsepower, a tall seat, and it changes direction far better than 2.2 tonnes should.

interior.notes: The model's own cabin: its steering wheel cut out to turn (tools/cars/urus_p.json), the eye placed by hand from section views; an automatic or dual clutch: the hands stay on the wheel.
